messages:
Evan T: Noticed a surge of duplicate prorate lines in NetSuite after the maintenance backfill ran at 03:10 UTC. About ~40 invoices affected in window 2026-03-19 03:05-03:20 UTC.

Priya S: Did the backfill touch the proration calculator or just re-ingest change events?

Evan T: It re-ingested historical change events. Suspect reprocessor produced duplicate messages for a handful of change_ids.

Ashwin: Quick check: our replayer had a bug where it retried batches on partial failure and would sometimes emit the same message twice when rate-limited. The consumer dedupe key is change_id + source_uuid; the replayer assigned a fresh source_uuid on retries.

Billing Bot: [alert] nightly-backfill job emitted 2xx warnings at 2026-03-19T03:15:02Z. Logs: /logs/backfill/2026-03-19/03/backfill-03.log

Evan T: Paste of the relevant lines:

```
2026-03-19T03:12:08Z INFO backfill emit change_id change_777 partition p3 source_uuid src_A
2026-03-19T03:12:20Z INFO backfill retry emit change_id change_777 partition p3 source_uuid src_B
2026-03-19T03:12:22Z INFO usage-prorate calc sub_900 delta -10 seats amount -40.00
2026-03-19T03:12:23Z INFO usage-prorate calc sub_900 (duplicate) delta -10 seats amount -40.00
2026-03-19T03:12:25Z INFO ns createInvoiceLine invoice 50033 line proration -40.00 id=ns_1333
2026-03-19T03:12:26Z INFO ns createInvoiceLine invoice 50033 line proration -40.00 id=ns_1334
```

Priya S: Ok. Scope query to find invoices with >1 proration lines in that timeframe.

Evan T: Ran a quick query:

```
SELECT invoice_num, customer_id, COUNT(*) as pr_count, SUM(amount) as total_pr
FROM ns_invoice_lines
WHERE memo ILIKE '%prorat%' AND created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-19 03:05' AND '2026-03-19 03:20'
GROUP BY invoice_num, customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
-- returns 38 rows
```

Priya S: Finance preference is to void duplicate NS line where possible rather than journal entry. We need a CSV: invoice_num, customer, duplicate_line_id, amount.

Ashwin: I can generate the CSV and a dry-run void script that validates net impact won't change expected invoice totals beyond the duplicate amount. Will require Priya's signoff.

Ops SRE: Paused backfill retries at 03:30 UTC. Also added debounce in backfill to prevent emitting the same change_id twice within a 60s window.

CS Rep: We have one customer complaining about billing change (TKT-6220). I'll prioritize outreach for deltas >$50 once Finance confirms remediation.

Priya S: Please don't run live voids until I confirm the CSV. Share artifact path when ready. Also add an automated alert for "proration-line-duplicates > 5 in 30m".

Billing Bot: [info] backfill-dryrun produced 38 candidates, total $1,520. Artifact: /artifacts/2026-03-19/backfill-prorate-dryrun-2168005555.csv

Ashwin: Artifact uploaded. Will open PR for patch that preserves source_uuid on retries and add unit/integration tests. Filed infra#5495.

Evan T: Thanks. Priya I will DM the CSV link; please ack when ready for live voids. Add note to billing runbook about backfill idempotency.

Priya S: Reviewing now. If all good, I'll approve a phased void (dry-run then 10% sample) to be safe.

Ops SRE: Noted. Leaving the backfill paused until patch merges and holds are green.

Evan T: Closing thread for now, will update after Priya ack. :white_check_mark:
